Choose Heavy Vibroblade for self-recovery through attacks or for defense and control that draw enemy attention.

Heavy Vibroblade - Immortal

Immortal includes attacks that generate extra enmity, defensive bonuses, and effects that hinder nearby enemies.

Berserker includes attacks that trade health for damage and strikes that restore health from damage dealt.
